==Description==
The '''Burst Buff''' was a buff that increased the tower's burst count, meaning they could fire more times during the burst, before having to wait because of its cooldown. This buff is no longer used as its purpose has been entirely replaced by golden perks.

==Mechanics==
The following tower used to have the '''Burst Buff''':
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Soldier]] (Passive)

**'''Burst Buff''' added.
*'''13 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.2]]
**'''Burst Buff''' removed.
